slots.name: Tiny Gym, Cartwheels Gym Centre (12 Armstrong Ave., Georgetown)
slots.age_fit: 1 and walking to 3 years, with their parent/caregiver; 45 minutes. 1-year-olds are strongly recommended to be fully independently walking before the term begins.
slots.price: No class price posted on the public site; pricing and availability are shown after logging into the registration website (terms vary in length). The registration page lists a $45.00 annual Gymnastics Ontario fee per child on the invoice.
slots.registration: Term 1/Fall registration was Wednesday July 22, 2026 at 8:00am online for all general programming (per the home page). Whether spots remain is only visible after logging in at https://cartwheelsgymcentre.uplifterinc.com/login/. The weekday, clock time and term dates are not on the pages I read; the 'Schedule at a glance' PDF link is a Term 2 2026-27 file that I did not open.

slots.name: Rock n' Roll with Miss Kelly, Cartwheels Gym Centre
slots.age_fit: 0+ years; 45 minutes. Music and movement class with sensory props and instruments.
slots.price: No class price posted on the public site; pricing and availability are shown after logging into the registration website. The registration page lists a $45.00 annual Gymnastics Ontario fee per child on the invoice.
slots.registration: The home page gives Term 1/Fall registration as Wednesday July 22, 2026 at 8:00am online for all general programming; this class is not named separately there. Availability is only visible after logging in at https://cartwheelsgymcentre.uplifterinc.com/login/. The weekday, clock time and term dates are not on the pages I read.

slots.name: Tumble & Learn, Cartwheels Gym Centre
slots.age_fit: 2y 11m to 4 years; 2 hours, drop-off. Includes a 45-minute gymnastics class, a music class, a learning activity, group games and a nut/peanut-free snack break.
slots.price: No class price posted on the public site; pricing and availability are shown after logging into the registration website. The registration page lists a $45.00 annual Gymnastics Ontario fee per child on the invoice.
slots.registration: Term 1/Fall registration was Wednesday July 22, 2026 at 8:00am online (Tumble n' Learn is named on the home page). It can be registered for an extended period covering Term 1 and Term 2. The weekday, clock time and term dates are not on the pages I read.

slots.name: Mini Gym, Cartwheels Gym Centre
slots.age_fit: 3/3½ to 4 years, without a parent; 45 minutes. The child must have just done Tiny Gym and show readiness to take part without a parent, OR already be 3½ when registering. The child must be fully toilet trained (no pull-ups). New children, or returning children after a break, who are not yet 3 years 6 months before the term start must register into Tiny Gym.
slots.price: No class price posted on the public site; pricing and availability are shown after logging into the registration website. The registration page lists a $45.00 annual Gymnastics Ontario fee per child on the invoice.
slots.registration: Term 1/Fall registration was Wednesday July 22, 2026 at 8:00am online for all general programming (per the home page). Mini Gym spots are described as limited. Availability is only visible after logging in at https://cartwheelsgymcentre.uplifterinc.com/login/. The weekday, clock time and term dates are not on the pages I read.
